Autonomous customer service agents handling tier-one cases without escalation
AI summarisation and next-step recommendations within Sales Cloud workflows
integrations: All Salesforce clouds: Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce
Data Cloud for unified customer data
governance_note: Agentforce is the clearest example of an autonomous customer-facing AI agent deployed at scale by a mainstream enterprise platform. The governance questions are: what can the agent commit to on behalf of the company, what happens when it gets it wrong, and how is that escalation path tested. Consumer-protection and financial-product regulations in several sectors require disclosures when a customer is interacting with AI rather than a human, and Agentforce interactions qualify. The disclosure requirement must be built into the agent's opening interaction, not treated as optional.
training_optout: Salesforce Zero Data Retention policy available for Einstein features. Agentforce interactions are stored in Salesforce under its data terms. Verify for your specific clouds and contracts.
